title: Instability and Morse Index of Exponentially Subelliptic Harmonic Maps
summary: Let $M$ be a closed manifold with a bracket-generating distribution $H$. We study the Morse index of exponentially subelliptic harmonic maps. After establishing finiteness, we estimate the index through two test spaces. The extrinsic one averages the index form over projected ambient parallel frames, reducing the estimate to a trace identity involving an extrinsic scalar with a quartic exponential term.
